tools.name: get_access_info
tools.description:
Describe SWATGenX access: accounts by invitation (for a named research collaboration or a
    funded study), studies quoted for each watershed, and calibration on account credit; how to
    request access. With an API key, also report the caller's current access and its status.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description:
Check a model build (authenticated): state (queued/running/complete/failed), stage,
    and timing. order_id is the id order_model returned for the build.
